description: The image consists of three side-by-side grouped bar charts, labeled (a) WikiText, (b) with a redacted title, and (c) C4, illustrating Perplexity across different Quantization Bits for two distinct methods. In all three charts, the horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Quantization Bits," with discrete values ordered ascendingly as 3, 4, 8, and 16. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Perplexity," using a linear scale. The value range and tick intervals vary across the subplots: charts (a) and (c) have a vertical axis ranging from 0 to slightly above 30 with tick intervals of 5, while chart (b) has a vertical axis ranging from 0 to 450 with tick intervals of 50. The charts feature grouped bars arranged side-by-side for each quantization bit category. According to the legend present in the upper left of each subplot, the blue bars represent the "Uniform" method, and the orange bars represent the "Ours" method. All bars are outlined in black. In chart (a) WikiText, the Uniform bars range from a high of approximately 31 at 3 bits to a low of about 26.5 at 8 and 16 bits, while the Ours bars range from roughly 21.5 at 3 bits to 18.5 at 8 and 16 bits. In chart (b), the Uniform bars range from approximately 420 at 3 bits to 300 at 8 and 16 bits, and the Ours bars range from about 245 at 3 bits to 180 at 8 and 16 bits. In chart (c) C4, the Uniform bars span from roughly 30 at 3 bits to 24.5 at 8 and 16 bits, whereas the Ours bars range from approximately 20.5 at 3 bits to 17.5 at 8 and 16 bits. The categories on the horizontal axis are sorted in ascending numerical order, and there are no visually emphasized bars beyond the standard color coding and black outlines.
